description: Apiosk is an EU-native data access layer for retrieving company records, filings, statistics, procurement data, and other specialist information from external APIs and data services. Ask in natural language and Apiosk identifies the relevant European sources, retrieves and normalizes the available data, and returns the result with source provenance. Use it for direct lookups or multi-step research across sources such as KVK, CBS, Eurostat, GLEIF, TenderNed, OpenSanctions and more sources will be added soon.

defaultPrompt: Which sources can provide Dutch company registration information?
